title: fix(a11y): name icon-only buttons and give clickable div/span controls a keyboard path (objectui#13461)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DMknEB2RRDpu49p9oqa9C6D)_

Fixes #13461

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

Icon-only buttons in the console get an accessible name, and the console's mouse-only clickable `div` / `span` controls become real buttons. A new deletions-only census keeps clickable `div` / `span` sites from coming back.

### Premise re-measured (the card's counts were a script reading)

The card's 25 / 24 came from a line-window script. Re-measured on the TypeScript AST at base `c85408f`:

- **Icon-only buttons.** Several of the card's examples already carry `aria-label` a few lines below the opening tag (the AI chat page, the invitations page, the chat dock), so they were never unnamed. The instrument that already re-derives this family is `iconOnlyButtonCensus-12143.test.ts` (it exists; the card says nobody filed it). This PR names every entry of its `BACKLOG` inside the claim's file surface (app-shell, components, fields, plugin-chatbot: 16 sites in 12 files) and deletes those rows. The top bar's avatar button, which that census cannot see (an `Avatar` is not an icon), is named too.
- **Clickable `div` / `span`.** The new census reads every `div` / `span` with an `onClick` and no `role`, `tabIndex` or key handler under `packages/*/src` and `apps/*/src`. Most sites are not controls: propagation guards around real buttons, scrims behind overlays, empty design-canvas backgrounds, and drag handles. Each is declared in `NOT_CONTROLS` with its reason. ⛔ None got `role="button"`.

### Repaired

| Where | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Organization picker card, "Manage" | a clickable `span` inside the card's `button` (unreachable by Tab, read as part of the card's name) | its own `button` beside the card button; `organization-manage-SLUG` test id |
| Flow canvas branch label | clickable `span`; the wide hit path is pointer-only | `role="button"`, `tabIndex`, `aria-pressed`, Enter / Space when the edge is selectable |
| `tree-view` node row | clickable `div` wrapped round the toggle `button`; toggle unnamed | the toggle is named (`common.expand` / `common.collapse`) with `aria-expanded`; the node is a `button` only when the host passes `onNodeClick` |
| `file-upload` dropzone | clickable `div` | `role="button"`, `tabIndex={0}`, Enter / Space opens the picker |
| App preview read-only nav row | an `onSelect` click handler that could never fire (the list renders only outside design mode, where the handler is undefined) | handler removed |

Icon-only buttons named: AI live canvas close (`common.close`), action result dialog secret toggle (`actions.resultDialog.showValue` / `hideValue`), permission set editor remove policy / remove tab (`perm.rls.remove` / `perm.tabs.remove`, designer table en + zh), metadata history refresh (`engine.edit.refresh`), sort builder remove (`sortBuilder.removeSort`), `file-upload` and `FileField` remove (`fields.file.remove`), `MasterDetailField` open / remove (`fields.masterDetail.*`), `PasswordField` toggle (`fields.password.*`), `QRCodeField` copy / toggle (`fields.qrCode.*`), legacy `Chatbot` send (`chatbot.sendMessage`), chat scroll-to-latest (`chatbot.scrollToBottom`, before the props spread so a caller's name wins), top bar avatar (`user.accountMenu`). New pack keys are in all ten packs.

### The census — `packages/components/src/__tests__/clickableNonControlCensus-13461.test.ts`

Same shape as the objectui#12143 and objectui#12145 censuses: an ordinary-suite test, ⛔ not a new CI gate. Sites are keyed by file, tag and handler (never by line); `NOT_CONTROLS` and `BACKLOG` are deletions-only and must equal what the scan finds. It carries width guards, a matcher fixture, and a stated blind-spot list (spread attributes, other tags, whether a reason is still true).

`BACKLOG` freezes 16 clickable controls that still have no keyboard path. 15 are outside the claim's file surface (plugin-ai, plugin-designer, plugin-gantt, plugin-grid, plugin-view). One is in app-shell: the studio data-form preview selects a field by a click delegated from its frame, and a keyboard path for that is a design question. The 12143 census keeps its 14 remaining plugin rows (plugin-ai, plugin-detail, plugin-list, plugin-view).

## Verification (head after the merge of main, `ecd30ca`)

- Ablation, done once and not kept: restored `OrganizationsPage.tsx` from `origin/main` and the new census went red with `OrganizationsPage.tsx · span · stopPropagation,navigate — declared 0, found 1`. Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, and `git diff HEAD` was empty.
- New and extended tests: `keyboardControls-13461.test.tsx` (components: tree toggle name and state, node button only with `onNodeClick`, zh pack; dropzone Enter / Space, remove-button name), `iconButtonNames-13461.test.tsx` (fields: password, QR code, master-detail names, zh pack), plus an `OrganizationsPage.test.tsx` case (Manage is a sibling button and does not switch org) and an `AppHeader.myOrganizations.test.tsx` case (avatar button name).
- Every test file that imports a changed module, plus every test that reads a changed file by path: 261 files in five runs, all passed before the merge. After the merge, the three censuses, the new tests and the tree-view catalog pin (`tree-view-nodes-mirror-6939`, 8 files, 54 tests) passed.
- `packages/i18n/` whole package: 87 files passed.
- `turbo run type-check` for app-shell, components, fields, plugin-chatbot and i18n with their dependencies: green after a test-typing fix in fields.
- Gates: `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-claims`, `check-pending-changeset-literals` and `check-changeset-fixed` all exit 0. ESLint on touched files: 0 errors with inline config. One `react-hooks/static-components` error appears under `--no-inline-config` in `AppPreview.tsx`, and `origin/main`'s copy of that file shows the same error.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:eager-locale-catalogues` (needs a built console bundle; CI builds first). The whole-repo `pnpm test` and `pnpm lint` are left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- Literal user-facing strings next to the touched controls are untouched (the legacy `Chatbot`'s empty-state line, `MasterDetailField`'s record count, `file-upload`'s launch copy, `ResourceHistoryPage`'s "Back to item"). They are outside this card.
- The optional per-route axe pass, a required axe check and repo-wide `eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y` are out of scope, per the claim.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
